patterns.note: A two-column layout with a fixed left sidebar and a main content area that dynamically expands horizontally on scroll by collapsing an initial right sidebar.
The primary hero text and call-to-action button remain fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, creating a persistent brand message.
Secondary content in the right sidebar is initially visible but disappears entirely on scroll, allowing the main content column to expand and take its place.
New content sections, including an article grid and a 'What's New' section within the fixed left sidebar, are revealed as the user scrolls down the page.
Article cards are presented in a two-column grid with a subtle border, featuring a thumbnail, title, author, and engagement metadata (time, comments, likes).

technique_notes: The left navigation bar is implemented as a fixed element, maintaining its position regardless of scroll depth.

The main hero content (text and CTA) is positioned to remain sticky at the top of the viewport, with subsequent page content scrolling underneath it, likely utilizing a scroll library like locomotive-scroll.
The site employs a responsive layout shift where an initial right sidebar is hidden or removed from the DOM on scroll, causing the main content area to reflow and occupy the full available width.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are bold and significantly larger than body text, establishing a clear hierarchy, while body text maintains a comfortable reading size.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied to interactive elements like buttons and article cards.
design_tokens.spacing: The layout is generally airy, particularly in the hero section and between main content blocks, but becomes denser within article cards and sidebar lists.

standout: The most distinctive design choice is the dynamic layout transformation where the right sidebar content disappears on scroll, allowing the main content area to expand horizontally. This, combined with the sticky hero text, creates a unique and focused scrolling experience.
